name: Chondroitin
short: In a review of 43 trials, adverse events were no more common than with placebo. With glucosamine, it is linked to bleeding risk and raised INR in people on anticoagulants such as warfarin.
text: In a systematic review of 43 randomised trials, chondroitin did not result in statistically significant numbers of adverse events or withdrawals due to adverse events compared with placebo or another drug, and the odds of serious adverse events were lower than with placebo; the reviewers noted that adverse events were reported in a limited fashion. A review of supplements and bleeding listed chondroitin-glucosamine among supplements associated with bleeding risk in people taking anticoagulants. Spontaneous reports describe altered coagulation (increased INR, bleeding or bruising) in people taking warfarin together with glucosamine or glucosamine-chondroitin products.
